reason: Re-opened packet.js quran 13 --verse 5.87: after reporting al-Suddi, Ikrima and al-Hasan, al-Tabari gives his own view that ‘la taʿtadu’ is general, no one may overstep God’s bound in what He made lawful or forbidden, and those who resolved to forbid themselves the lawful were reproached only (innama) for passing beyond what was laid down; all three evidence pieces string-match. His gloss likening the self-deniers to priests and monks is left out, as rule 4 needs.
